title: N E D University of Engineering and Technology Amending Act 2006

sections.shortTitle: N E D University of Engineering and Technology Amending Act 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2006
ACT XVII OF 2006
N.E.D. UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING
AND TECHNOLOGY
(AMENDING) ACT, 2006
An Act to amend the N.E.D. University
of Engineering
and Technology Act, 1977
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV
27th December, 2006]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-10/2006, dated
22-12-2006.---The NED University of Engineering and Technology (Amending) Bill,
2006 have been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on Wednesday, the 15th November, 2006 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on Monday, the 18th December, 2006, is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the N.E.D. University
of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the N.E.D. University
of Engineering and Technology (Amending) Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment of the Section 15 of the Sindh Act No.III of 1977.---In
the N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977, in section 15,
subsection (1) in clause (xii), the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a
semi colon and the word "and", and thereafter the following new
clause shall be added:-

representative of the Husein Ebrahim
Foundation."
